description: He wears a muted grey-teal textured deel with a crossed front and a hem between knee and calf. Tan-gold knot-and-cloud borders and small motifs decorate the front and edges; a narrow cream inner collar shows at the neck. Brown full sleeves and dark brown forearm cuffs display diamond-pattern decoration and small fastenings. A wide brown patterned sash and belt close at a large round bronze-toned ornamental buckle, with a long brown fringed end. Loose brown trousers tuck into dark brown calf-high boots with gold-toned scrolling shaft patterns. No headgear or weapon is visible.
